commitments.claim: FY26 AI infrastructure orders from hyperscalers raised to $9B and FY26 AI revenue raised to $4B (from $3B), implying a ~$1.7B Q4 AI revenue ramp and large FY27 backlog conversion
Restructuring plan of up to $1B to reinvest in silicon, optics, security and AI; ~$450M recognized in Q4 FY26, remainder during FY27
Major multi-year, multi-billion-dollar campus networking refresh underway; campus orders +25% y/y, data center switching orders +40% y/y
Capital return: $0.42/share quarterly dividend declared (paid July 22, 2026) and $9.6B remaining buyback authorization with no termination date
Q4 FY26 non-GAAP gross margin 65.5%-66.5% and non-GAAP operating margin 34%-35%, inclusive of estimated tariff impact under current trade policy

buy_triggers.marker: Q4 FY26 revenue >= $17.0B with product revenue growth >= 15% y/y and non-GAAP gross margin >= 66.0%, showing the AI ramp is not diluting margin
Initial FY27 revenue guidance implying >= 9% growth (>= $68.7B) plus disclosed FY26 AI orders >= $9B with a raised FY27 AI revenue target
Total RPO growth reaccelerating to >= 8% y/y with product RPO growth >= 10%
Quarterly CFO >= $4.5B with inventory growth decelerating below product revenue growth (inventory build normalizing)
buy_triggers.checkable_at: Q4 FY26 8-K cash flow statement and FY26 10-K balance sheet (Sep 2026)

sell_triggers.checkable_at: Q1 FY27 and Q2 FY27 earnings 8-Ks (Nov 2026, Feb 2027)

thesis.what_must_be_true: The hyperscaler AI systems ramp must convert the $9B FY26 order book into revenue at roughly the guided pace without pushing non-GAAP gross margin below ~65%; the campus refresh must keep ex-hyperscaler orders growing; tariff costs must stay near the levels embedded in guidance; and the inventory build plus restructuring cash costs must prove transitory so CFO reverts to a >$15B annual run-rate in FY27, funding ~$6.7B dividends and ~$6B buybacks.

validated.preview_note: Cisco reports FQ4/FY26 results with the bar raised after a Q3 that beat the high end on both lines (revenue $15.84B, +12%; non-GAAP EPS $1.06). Guidance is $16.7-16.9B revenue and $1.16-1.18 non-GAAP EPS; we expect ~$17.0B and $1.18, a modest beat consistent with the recent pattern. Three things matter. First, the AI trajectory: management raised FY26 hyperscaler AI orders to $9B and AI revenue to $4B, implying a ~$1.7B Q4 AI contribution — watch whether orders keep compounding and whether an FY27 AI revenue target near $8-9B is offered. Second, gross margin: non-GAAP GM guided 65.5-66.5% as lower-margin AI systems mix scales; a print at 66% or better with double-digit product growth would rebut the dilution bear case, while sub-65.5% would confirm it. Third, the initial FY27 guide: with RPO at $43.5B and campus refresh orders +25%, we think Cisco guides Q1 FY27 to ~$17.0-17.2B and FY27 revenue to ~$68.5-69.5B; anything implying sub-8% growth disappoints. GAAP optics will be noisy — the newly announced restructuring puts ~$450M into Q4 GAAP results (GAAP EPS guided $0.80-0.85). Cash flow deserves attention: FY26 CFO is tracking below FY25 on tax timing and a ~$1.5B AI-driven inventory build; a Q4 CFO print near $4.5B+ would ease conversion concerns. Reaction will hinge on the FY27 revenue guide and the AI order/margin combination more than on the Q4 beat itself.
validated.reasoning: Q4 revenue of $17.0B (+15.6% y/y) sits just above the $16.9B guidance ceiling, mirroring Q3's above-high-end beat and supported by record orders (+35%), $43.5B RPO, and the raised $4B FY26 AI revenue target requiring ~$1.7B in Q4. GAAP GM of 63.8% maps to ~66.0% non-GAAP (mid-guidance; AI mix dilution offset by cost discipline). Opex reflects seasonal Q4 S&M step-up, continued R&D investment, and the announced $450M restructuring charge. GAAP tax ~15.8% (guide ~16%) gives net income $3,347M, EPS $0.84; the non-GAAP bridge (SBC $920M, intangibles amortization $450M, acquisition costs $60M, restructuring $450M, investment gains -$50M, tax effect -$475M at ~19% non-GAAP rate) yields $4,702M and $1.18 EPS. FY26 totals: revenue $63.07B (above the $62.8-63.0B guide), non-GAAP EPS $4.29, CFO $13.4B (down y/y on ~$2.3B tax timing and inventory build), capex $1.5B, FCF ~$11.9B. Q4 CFO of $4.6B assumes partial working-capital relief vs Q3 but continued inventory investment and mostly-accrued restructuring. Capital return: $1.66B dividend plus ~$1.5B buybacks against the $9.6B authorization; balance sheet rolls to $127.0B assets with cash roughly flat. FY27: AI revenue roughly doubling (~$8-9B), campus refresh, and security stabilization drive ~12% growth to $70.8B with non-GAAP EPS ~$4.98; margins dip slightly on mix (GM ~65.3-65.7%) while restructuring savings hold OM ~34.5-35%. Quarterly-path margins are stated on a non-GAAP basis, consistent with how Cisco guides.
